More QPs Is NOT Always Better — RNIC On-Chip QPC SRAM Is Finite!
• Splits each collective chunk into 4 concurrent 100G sub-flows
with 4 distinct UDP source ports for smooth 4-way ECMP spraying

• Scales back to `QPS=1..2` on all-to-all MoE to prevent $O(N)$ QP bloat
